source_frame: Native direct DOCX files and DOCX ZIP members in every same-WG meeting-number/bis folder, including city/electronic suffixes. All candidates are inventoried before comparison. Meeting labels used in frozen comparisons remain unchanged.
admission: Exact retained/native DOCX bytes, exact main-document XML, or equality of every ordered visible-body paragraph/cell after the existing whitespace normalization. Body equivalence does not imply whole-package equivalence.
agenda: Recognize native heading styles including basedOn/outlineLvl and native tab separators. Require an explicit literal heading number. Automatic numbering is not reconstructed and clears the nearest-heading scope. Heading evidence is structural provenance, not expert adjudication.
